full_judgment:
Md Gholam Rabbani J: Petitioner instituted SCC Suit No. 7 of 1997 in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge and SCC Judge, Dhaka, against Md Ashraf Ali (who died during the pendency of the suit) alleging that the said defendant was his monthly tenant in respect of the suit premises and that he was liable to be ejected as being defaulter in the payment of rent. The suit was ultimately contested by the substituted heirs (widow and two daughters) of the deceased defendant. The suit was decreed by the learned SCC Judge by the judgment and decree dated 17-1-1999. The defendant No. 1 who is the widow of the deceased defendant then moved the High Court Division in its revisional jurisdiction under section 25 of the Small Cause Courts Act. The High Court Division by the judgment and order dated 13-6-2000 passed in Civil Revision No. 619 of 1999 made the Rule absolute and dismissed the suit. 

 The petition is, therefore, dismissed with the observation as above. Consequently the aforesaid judgment and order of the High Court Division as well as the judgment and decree of the SCC Court are set aside and the learned SCC Judge is directed to return the plaint to the filing learned Advocate of the plaintiff with the endorsement under his signature thereon the date of its presentation, the date of return and the remark, ''The plaintiff may present the plaint to a Court having jurisdiction to determine the title."
